58:12.text: O you who believe! When you
in private, spend something in charity before your private consultation. That will be better and purer for you. But if you find not
, then verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

58:13.text: Are you afraid of spending in charity before your private consultation
? If then you do it not, and Allâh has forgiven you, then
and give Zakât and obey Allâh
(i.e. do all that Allâh and His Messenger صلى الله عليه وسلم order you to do)
. And Allâh is All-Aware of what you do.

58:14.text: who take as friends a people upon whom is the Wrath of Allâh
, and they swear to a lie while they know.

58:15.text: Allâh has prepared for them a severe torment. Evil indeed is that which they used to do.

58:16.text: They have made their oaths a screen
from the Path of Allâh: so they shall have a humiliating torment.

58:17.text: Their children and their wealth will avail them nothing against Allâh. They will be the dwellers of the Fire to dwell therein forever.

58:18.text: On the Day when Allâh will resurrect them all together
; then they will swear to Him as they swear to you
. And they think that they have something

58:19.text: has overpowered them. So he has made them forget the remembrance of Allâh. They are the party of Shaitân
. Verily, it is the party of Shaitan

58:20.text: Those who oppose Allâh and His Messenger
they will be among the lowest

58:21.text: Allâh has decreed: "Verily, it is I and My Messengers who shall be the victorious." Verily, Allâh is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.
